products.name: AWS Landing Zone & Organizations Baseline — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a governed AWS foundation — multi-account Organizations, OUs, guardrails, and centralized logging done right from day one.
products.description:
Build a governed AWS foundation — multi-account Organizations, OUs, guardrails, and centralized logging done right from day one.

A single AWS account with root access everywhere is a breach and a billing surprise waiting to happen. This solution stands up a governed multi-account foundation — AWS Organizations with an OU structure, a landing zone (Control Tower or Terraform), service control policies (SCPs), centralized CloudTrail/Config logging, and account-baseline guardrails.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Terraform, CLI & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • AWS Organizations + OU hierarchy and account structure
  • Landing zone (Control Tower or Terraform) with account vending
  • Service Control Policies (SCPs) as preventive guardrails
  • Centralized CloudTrail, AWS Config, and a log-archive account
  • Account baseline (IAM password policy, default encryption, regions)

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A governed, multi-account AWS foundation with guardrails and centralized logging — repeatable account vending instead of click-ops sprawl.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AWSLZ-Deploy.sh — plan-first, approval-gated Terraform wrapper for the landing zone
    • AWSLZ-Discovery.sh — inventory current AWS Organizations / landing-zone state (read-only)
    • AWSLZ-Report.sh — posture report: accounts by OU, SCP attachments, logging, baseline (read-only)
    • AWSLZ-Validate.sh — run the 05-testing pass/fail gates for the landing zone (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
